headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.coarseSingletonTable_subsingleton
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (z : Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L),
  (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length ≤ 1 ∨
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length ≤ 1 →
    Subsingleton
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.Table (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseRows r c U L hr z)
        (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseColumns r c U L hc z))

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.completionDraw_eq_singleton

      (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length ≤ 1 →

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawCompletionResidual_singleton
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (z : Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L),
  (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length ≤ 1 ∨
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length ≤ 1 →
    ∀ (h N : ℕ),
      Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.bits r c U L hr hc z h ≤ N →
        ∀ (word : Fin N → Bool),
          Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawCompletionResidual (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U L
              (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L z) h (List.ofFn word) =
            Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawSingletonCompletionCode
              (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawCoarseRows (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U L
                (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L z))
              (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawCoarseColumns (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U L
                (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L z))

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawSingletonCompletionCode_draw
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (z : Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L) (emptyWord : Fin 0 → Bool),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawSingletonCompletionCode
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawCoarseRows (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U L
        (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L z))
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawCoarseColumns (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U L
        (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L z)) =
    OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode
      ↑((Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.finiteFibreEquiv r c U L hr hc z)
          (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.singletonCompletionDraw r c U L hr hc z emptyWord))
